issue.title: pytest tmpdir broad-root check misses macOS /tmp and /var/tmp after symlink resolve
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `tests/test_run_pytest_tmpdir.py::test_configured_pytest_tmpdir_rejects_broad_cleanup_targets`

`tools/run_pytest._configured_pytest_tmpdir` rejects overrides whose `.resolve()` is in `{Path("/"), Path("/tmp"), Path("/var/tmp")}`. On macOS `/tmp` and `/var/tmp` are symlinks, so `Path("/tmp").resolve()` is `/private/tmp` and `Path("/var/tmp").resolve()` is `/private/var/tmp`, which are not in that unresolved set. The `[unsafe_root1]` (`/tmp`) and `[unsafe_root2]` (`/var/tmp`) cases therefore do not raise. Reproduced twice on this tree. `/`, `ROOT`, and `ROOT.parent` still fail as expected.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Failed twice on this tree for unsafe_root /tmp and /var/tmp. _configured_pytest_tmpdir compares Path.resolve() against unresolved Path("/tmp") and Path("/var/tmp"); on macOS those resolve to /private/tmp and /private/var/tmp and slip through. Slash, ROOT, and ROOT.parent still reject.
